content: {"resolution":"answered","answer":"Two things do this, both in vpn.md. An expired node key looks exactly like a working login with no traffic \u2014 run tailscale up --force-reauth and sign in again; contractors hit this every 90 days. If reauth does not fix it, cafe wifi blocking UDP will push Tailscale onto a relay, which is slow rather than broken, and matches it working in the office."}
